[DOCKET REVIEW SEAT REQUEST · docket.review_seat_requested·object.slug "docket.review_seat_requested·object.title"] docket.review_seat_requested·requested_by is asking you to grant docket.review_seat_requested·reviewer the REVIEW SEAT on this docket item. You are being asked because you are the nearest agent who is both above docket.review_seat_requested·reviewer and owner-level on this item — an owner may name only itself, its own subtree or its own superior as reviewer, so a peer reviewer is yours to authorize and nobody else's.
Why: docket.review_seat_requested·note
The item belongs to docket.review_seat_requested·owner and stays with them: granting the seat lets them NAME docket.review_seat_requested·reviewer as reviewer. It hands over read, evidence, the one review decision and participant-level state control — not the item.
Grant it with orgtree_work action='review_grant' reviewer=docket.review_seat_requested·reviewer items=['docket.review_seat_requested·object.slug'], or turn it down with action='review_revoke' slug=docket.review_seat_requested·object.slug reviewer=docket.review_seat_requested·reviewer and a `note` saying why.
Read the item first with orgtree_work get slug=docket.review_seat_requested·object.slug.
